cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Ready on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've set a timer like you. One-question conversations; sensible. I'll discuss last night's rent argument, not the whole year.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's for the oven. The whole year matters; you've been pulling away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the timer running. Ask one question, and let me finish before you answer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Were you going to move out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I packed a bag. It's still upstairs. Please let that be the whole answer until the timer goes.

reason: Tie mistaken imitation to the actual hopeful redirect, outward comfort, reciprocal-risk bargain, bounded vulnerability, or feared ending; keep material partner contributions and natural requests.
